SELECT count(*)::int AS drop_count
FROM chinmay_astro.silent_drop
WHERE phone_number = $1
  AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';

INSERT INTO chinmay_astro.users (phone_number, status, blocked_reason, blocked_at, blocked_by, created_at, updated_at, last_message_at)
VALUES ($1, 'blocked', $2, NOW(), 'WF-61', NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
ON CONFLICT (phone_number) DO UPDATE SET
  status = 'blocked',
  blocked_reason = $2,
  blocked_at = NOW(),
  blocked_by = 'WF-61',
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, phone_number, status, blocked_reason;
